_about: Bezier anatomy of shipped marks, measured 2026-10-10 with tools/logo_curves.mjs. marks = knowledge/benchmarks/logos/marks/*.svg (32, sources in ../CREDITS.md); svgl = 61 SVGs from github.com/pheralb/svgl static/library (parsed as text, not stored).
